notes:
Topline: Claimesis is an EU-based litigation support & compliance vendor (mid-enterprise legal teams) evaluating a private/VPC RAG stack for regulated customer discovery products. Key ask: high-scale embeddings + two-stage rerank with strict retention/audit controls.

Customer quotes / voice: "Need search p95 <350ms end-to-end for legal search (top10 rerank included)." Wants transparent cost per query; target <= $0.05 across average search traffic.

Requirements summary:
- Corpus: target ingest ~20M documents (~200M pages) initially, steady-state growth ~30%/yr.
- Indexing: embeddings at 1536 dims (open to quantized variants), ANN index HNSW/IVF for scale; snapshotting & incremental re-index support required.
- Reranking: bi-encoder recall + cross-encoder top-10 cross-attention rerank. Expect rerank CPU/GPU tradeoff; customer wants fallback to cheaper reranker for high QPS.
- Latency: p95 search (ANN + rerank) target <350ms (EU region). POC baseline target: 250-300ms.
- Throughput: burst up to 400 qps, sustained 120 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement target $0.02-$0.05/query; willing to pay more for lower p95 but wants monthly cost breakdown by model/batch.
- Security: VPC private deployment with customer-managed KMS, audit logging retained 7 years, SSO/SAML, SOC2/ISO27001 proof, GDPR/data residency to EU only. Some customers require HSM-backed keys.
- Retention: per-customer retention windows; ability to purge and produce retention reports for audits.

Recent activities / timeline (CRM style):
- 2025-01-14: Inbound demo request from engineering lead (Lina Hofmann).
- 2025-01-22: Intro call (Avery + SE). Fireflies: ff_2025-01-22_claimesis_intro. Notes: strong interest in private deployment, asked for SSO and audit screenshot.
- 2025-01-28: Sent security questionnaire + initial infra diagram (drive link).
- 2025-02-03: Architecture review w/ SE Diego Morales — discussed ANN choice, rerank strategy, and expected cost envelope.
- 2025-02-05: Legal submitted follow-up: retention policy clarifications + ELA redlines. Jira INF-8421 opened for benchmarking ask.
- 2025-02-07: POC SOW draft shared; awaiting sign-off.

POC plan (high level):
- Deliverables: ingest 500k sample docs mirroring their corpora, measure indexing time, ANN recall, end-to-end latency with cross-encoder rerank for top-10. Produce cost model for projected 20M doc scale.
- Success metrics: nearest-neighbor recall@50 > 0.9, p95 search <350ms, total cost per query <= $0.05 in private config.
- Timeline: 4-week POC once NDA + sample data provided.

Sales notes / negotiation points:
- Customer prefers Private (VPC) with option to run Dedicated for peak bursts.
- Must provide detailed audit logging and retention controls (7y) in contract.
- Procurement pushing for annual committed spend with break clauses tied to SLA.

Open questions for engineering/security:
- Can Redwood provide HSM/KMS integration in Private deployment (customer requires HSM for some datasets)?
- Rerank cost optimization: ability to use CPU cross-encoder or offload to dedicated GPU pool for top-10 only?
- Snapshot & incremental indexing cadence — support for near-real-time updates (target sub-5min indexing for litigation hold tags).

Next steps (as of 2025-02-07):
- Schedule deep-dive design workshop (arch + security) w/ Lina and infra team (owner: Avery) — target 2025-02-14.
- Finalize NDA + provide sample dataset (customer).
- Stand up POC infra and run baseline indexing job (SE: Diego).
